study_system.sampling_frame: national 10 x 10 km grid used consistently across four survey cycles
study_system.scientific_role: fresh EOG-specific validation candidate for the post-Glanville two-layer predictor

known_from_publication: national tiger occupancy expanded substantially between 2006 and 2018
the same 10 x 10 km grid framework was used across four survey cycles
sign surveys and model-based occupancy estimation were used
published aggregate extent and growth were viewed only to establish endpoint plausibility
independence_boundary.label: fresh EOG-specific validation; not completely outcome-naive ecological-system validation
independence_boundary.rule: Published aggregate findings may justify process relevance, comparator class and event-count plausibility, but may not tune EOG thresholds, Layer-B features, holdout blocks, model hyperparameters, metrics or favourable/adverse rules.

source.source_freeze_rule: freeze exact workbook bytes and the complete XLSX ZIP/member manifest before interpreting worksheet roles

allowed_at_gate0_inventory: exact XLSX bytes for checksum verification
ZIP member names, sizes, CRC values and SHA-256 fingerprints
workbook.xml sheet names and relationship metadata
the first logical worksheet row only when it can be decoded without reading later cells
shared-string records only as far as strictly required to resolve first-row header references
forbidden_at_gate0_inventory: any worksheet row after the first logical row
cached formula values outside header cells
grid occupancy, presence, absence, sign-detection or abundance values
loading the workbook with pandas or openpyxl
using worksheet order or hidden sheets as a substitute for documented scientific role
response_firewall.implementation_rule: inspect the XLSX as a ZIP/XML package; do not deserialize spreadsheet tables through a general workbook library

node_universe_gate.critical_question: Does the workbook contain a separate response-free registry for the constant national grid, including stable grid IDs and deterministic geometry?
pass_if: a worksheet or table is documented as the survey/grid frame rather than an occupancy result
geometry is available as coordinates, grid row/column plus a declared origin/CRS, or an explicit pairwise-distance representation
the registry is independent of future tiger occupancy
survey availability/effort can be joined without opening occupancy outcomes
stop_if: geometry exists only in rows that also contain occupancy or future response values
grid IDs cannot be mapped deterministically across cycles
worksheet role cannot be established without reading response rows
geometry is absent or requires reconstruction from figures

response_semantics_gate.candidate_target: later-cycle survey-recorded tiger occurrence/occupancy among grid cells eligible under the archived survey design
response_semantics_gate.positive_candidate: grid-cycle with archived tiger sign/presence under the declared survey protocol
response_semantics_gate.negative_candidate: surveyed eligible grid-cycle with archived non-detection/absence under the same protocol
response_semantics_gate.missing_candidate: not surveyed, unavailable or structurally missing grid-cycle; excluded rather than recoded as absence
response_semantics_gate.pass_requirement: worksheet schema/documentation must distinguish surveyed non-detection from missing/not-surveyed before any response value is opened
response_semantics_gate.stop_requirement: if zeros cannot be separated from missing/unsurveyed cells, stop before outcome access

source_process_gate.prospective_source_state: grid cells recorded occupied in the preceding survey cycle
source_process_gate.claim_boundary: forecast is conditional on the archived preceding-cycle occupied grid state and the declared national sampling frame; it does not identify dispersal routes, ancestry or complete demographic closure
source_process_gate.external_recruitment_boundary: unrepresented immigration and demographic processes remain outside the finite-world certificate unless a response-free external-source representation is prospectively documented
source_process_gate.stop_if: the workbook exposes only per-cycle outputs without stable cross-cycle grid identity or an admissible preceding-cycle source state

event_count_feasibility.interpretation: the published occupied-area scale makes a nontrivial transition endpoint plausible; it is not an observed colonization-event count and cannot tune the frozen event threshold

two_layer_architecture_freeze.latent_layer: exact frozen rule identities retained for compatibility, source-conditioned propagation, contraction and finite-universe falsification

structural_gate_if_gate0_passes.distance_basis: response-free cell centroids or an exact response-free distance representation only
structural_gate_if_gate0_passes.scale_rule: reuse the unchanged 0.25/0.50/0.75/0.90 largest-component structural ladder
requirements: at least three distinct positive structural thresholds
structural_gate_if_gate0_passes.no_rescue: do not introduce kNN, arbitrary thresholds or response-derived geometry after a structural-scale failure

holdout_and_comparator_direction_if_elig.temporal_direction: use earlier cycles to calibrate and preserve the final 2018 cycle as a genuinely future cycle; add prospectively declared spatial outer units because there is only one final temporal transition
holdout_and_comparator_direction_if_elig.same_world_comparator: a scalar/mean compression of the exact same frozen worlds
external_comparators: published-style dynamic/spatial occupancy model using the same response-free effort and habitat covariates
fixed flexible classifier using the same response-free covariates
holdout_and_comparator_direction_if_elig.freeze_later: exact blocks, event threshold, features, hyperparameters and metrics are frozen only after source, grid registry, geometry and structural adequacy pass, still before occupancy response rows

pass_if_all: exact Zenodo workbook bytes are reproducibly frozen
worksheet/table roles can be inventoried without response rows
a separate response-free constant-grid registry exists
stable grid identity and complete geometry are deterministic
surveyed non-detection can be distinguished from missing/not-surveyed
preceding-cycle occupied cells form a scientifically bounded conditional source state
stop_if_any: cross-cycle IDs are unstable or ambiguous
survey effort/non-detection semantics are not auditable
source-process semantics are incompatible with a conditional forecast

post_inventory_sequence: adjudicate worksheet/table roles from metadata and published documentation
parse only a proven response-free grid/geometry table
freeze the canonical cell universe and structural fingerprints
run the unchanged response-blind structural adequacy Gate 1
freeze source update, Layer B, same-world and external comparators, spatial blocks, runtime and stop rules
synthetic-smoke the complete outcome runner without response
no_rescue_rule: If any Gate 0 or structural condition fails, close unmerged and move to another candidate rather than weakening the firewall, geometry or endpoint.
